prompt: An online retailer's traffic rose 30% this year, but orders were flat. Which is the strongest initial hypothesis?

options.text: Something is off with the business.
options.feedback: Too vague to test; say what is off and how you'd check.

options.text: Conversion fell, possibly because the new traffic is lower-intent; I'd compare conversion by traffic source.
options.feedback: Right. It is directional, uses the facts and names the test.

options.text: Traffic is up 30% and orders are flat.
The checkout redesign broke conversion, full stop.
options.feedback: Overconfident: it may be true, but it needs testing first.

explanation: Flat orders on higher traffic means conversion fell. The best hypothesis picks a cause and names the cut of data that tests it.
